mapper.sql: select txn_id, member_id, type, amount_cents, fee_cents, counterparty, status, order_id, create_time from hys_wallet_txn
mapper.select: where member_id = #{memberId} order by txn_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into hys_wallet_txn (member_id, type, amount_cents, fee_cents, counterparty, status, order_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{amountCents}, #{feeCents}, #{counterparty}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_wallet_txn set status = #{status} where txn_id = #{txnId}
